It's great to have you here at Mohegan Sun. If you're looking for something that stands out, Todd English's Tuscany in the Casino of the Sky is my top recommendation. The wood-fired aroma from the open kitchen sets a warm, sophisticated tone that pairs perfectly with their handmade pastas and modern Italian dishes. 

They are open until 10:00 PM tonight with a $$$$ price range, and business casual dress is the way to go. I'd suggest a reservation since it's a popular Saturday night choice. What kind of flavors usually catch your eye when you're exploring a new menu? After dinner, you might want to stop by the Bow & Arrow sports bar in the Casino of the Earth for a more casual atmosphere.

Bobby Flay’s Bar Americain in the Casino of the Earth really captures that celebrity chef energy with a menu that's all about bold, regional American flavors. The atmosphere has a lively brasserie feel, and his signature Southwest touches on dishes like the grilled meats and seafood are what keep people coming back. 

They are open until 11:00 PM tonight with a price range of $$$ and a smart casual dress code, and I definitely recommend a reservation for a Saturday night. Since you appreciate a chef-driven menu, are you more in the mood for a signature steak or are you leaning toward something from the raw bar? After dinner, you might enjoy walking over to the Wolf Den nearby to catch some free live music.

They’re open until 11:00 PM tonight with a $$ price range, and since they don't take reservations, you can just walk right up in your casual gear.
